data.long_meaning: Mabu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mati' which means 'intelligence' and 'Budhi' which means 'wisdom'. The name Mabu is a perfect name for a child who is believed to be intelligent and wise even before they are born. The name Mabu carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Mabu usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
